# Sarah

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Sarah is described as having thin cheeks. She is noted to have a proud flush upon them.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063)_

## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah liked Luther Wallace, but her father sent him away because he was poor. Over the years, she maintained her home's duckhouse, whitewashing it every spring for fear it might eventually be needed. Years later, after returning home during a rainstorm to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) trapped in the roof of her duckhouse, Sarah freed her with an axe and invited her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) inside for tea. While complaining about her sister Martha, Sarah agreed to sell [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a blue willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars to help fund her own upcoming marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P2](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0002), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P4](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0004), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P5](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0005), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P7](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0007), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P8](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0008), +25 more_
